strategies.name: karpathy
strategies.applicability: Mandatory when a task has (or can be given) a scalar metric and a stable frozen evaluator; iterate one change at a time, keep only if improvement exceeds 2x the noise floor.

strategies.name: ralph-wiggum
strategies.applicability: Brute-force repeat-until-done for tasks with no automatable verifier; each iteration reads the current repo state, attempts progress, commits, and exits; memory is files and git; fresh context each iteration; bounded by a hard iteration cap.

strategies.name: octopus
strategies.applicability: Coordinator-class: @octopus is the sole builder; it dispatches read-only @octopus-arm persona lenses to feel the SPEC (pre-build) and implementation (post-build), integrates their evidence-backed perceptions, and builds. For high-risk, multi-lens tasks where a single reviewer pass would miss things. Default 3 arms, bounded 3 rounds. Subject to an admission test; not a default strategy.
